author: Abyssus_Deus
body: They are pretty easy as you don't get any T10 bosses until floor 17, so you'll be fully buffed and slapping them silly.

author: Greeve78
body: I think you’ll be fine. I am super protective and probably overkill with Ward and the like but I don’t think you’ll have any issues. The only hard part is running into a berserked boss and that is why I Ward up significantly at the start of the gauntlet.

author: Hawksparre
body:
As already mentioned, floor 17-22 are all t10 bosses ( hades, anubis, odin and then the arisen gods/mammon ONLY maybe on the 22nd floor ), so as long as you make sure you're fully buffed by floor 16 you'll be fine unless you get a beserk surprise. 

You wont have to worry about keys at all really. I've gone from 1200 keys to 2300+ since hitting t10 doing normal boss gauntlets.

author: Abyssus_Deus
body: I do a set (about 6) of boss hards once a week and haven't noticed my keys dropping significantly.

author: Templet
body:
My thoughts on this,

After hitting tier 10, the gauntlets were not significantly harder. I did lose occasionally to berserk bosses, but that's pretty standard. Hitting a berserk boss is often like hitting a brick wall.

I switched my dragon scroll off to a good shield, ward became important again. I spent a lot of time (indeed, still spending it) grinding out good new tier gear. I play mage, so went with an ornate Acolyte robe (199%), an ornate Lyonesse Crown (196%) and a pair of Legendary ifrit feet (150%, looking for better).

After that the runs are pretty simple, and I have NO WORRIES about keys, because it doesn't matter what I do, they just come in like crazy now.

author: Ryusoushen
body: Only hard t10 boss excluding zerks is anubis when he uses his multi hit melee attk and all t10 bosses have a ward activating skill, even arisen mammon is laughable ive yet to see a zerk arisen god or mam in there.i was lucky to.get the only t10 boss drop i needed early lyonese crown now i just do hard mode norm gaunts to try and get boosted % drop on ifrit feet and arisen gods and mammon still spawn in normal gauntlets, also for real find a water spot and farm the mimics/cthulu great for keys/rods off the mimics.

body: Currently a battlemage working on getting ornate t7 gear, how viable am i for completing boss runs? Can i def red 2 and 1 and be good for the most part? Where can i get strong ward spells?

body: Not too bad, and they are really valuable b/c you can get some an awesome helm (Lyonesse Crown) and weapons there floors 17 -22
